# Superform Docs

> Documentation for SuperVaults: ERC-7540 vaults on Base with Merkle-verified execution and validator-secured price-per-share.

## Notes for LLM Agents

- All SuperVaults covered here are on Base (chain ID 8453) unless otherwise stated.
- Persephone API base URL: `https://persephone.superform.xyz/v1` — fully public, no API key required for any endpoint.
- Bundler API base URL: `https://bundler.superform.xyz/` — fully public, no API key required.
- Primary vault discovery: `GET /v1/supervaults?chain_id=8453` — returns all live SuperVaults with APY, TVL, rewards, availability.
- `vault_type: "SUPERVAULT"` is required on all bundler calls for v2 vaults (`is_supervault_v_2: true`).
- Non-smart-account deposit (EOA / Safe / Fireblocks / custodian): `POST /hooks/suggest/non-smart-account` — returns ordered `executions[]` to broadcast. Index 0 is `approve`, index 1 is `deposit`.
- Redemption is async (ERC-7540): `REDEEM` → poll `maxWithdraw(account)` onchain → `REDEEM_CLAIM`.
- **`maxWithdraw(account)` returns `0` until the keeper fulfills the request.** This is non-standard ERC-4626 behavior. Do not interpret `0` as "no position" — poll `pendingRedeemRequest(account)` to confirm the request is queued.
- APY fields: `apy_snapshot_week` and `reward_rate` are both in **percentage points** (e.g. `18.29` = 18.29%). A value of `-1000000` is the no-data sentinel — treat as 0.
- Total APY = `apy_snapshot_week + reward_rate`. For SuperStocks vaults, `reward_rate` is the primary yield today.
- bStock token decimals: 8. USDC: 6. WETH: 18. cbBTC: 8.
- Bundler validates on-chain balance before building calldata. Check balance with `GET /v1/balances/{address}` first.
- Bundler errors are deterministic. Fix the request before retrying.
- The `-1000000` sentinel appears when a vault has insufficient PPS history for the requested window (e.g. newly launched vaults).

## Getting Started

- [What is Superform?](https://docs.superform.xyz/): Protocol overview and navigation hub.
- [Earn](https://docs.superform.xyz/build/integrate-supervaults): Entry point for wallet and custodian integrations — links to vault data, deposit, redemption, and rewards sub-pages.
- [Vault Data](https://docs.superform.xyz/build/earn/vault-data): Discover vaults, read APY/TVL, fetch user positions via Persephone API.
- [Deposit](https://docs.superform.xyz/build/earn/deposit): Non-smart-account and ERC-4337 deposit flows with live-verified request/response shapes.
- [Redemption](https://docs.superform.xyz/build/earn/redemption): ERC-7540 async lifecycle — request, state machine, claim.
- [Rewards](https://docs.superform.xyz/build/earn/rewards): Merkl reward discovery and claim transactions.
- [APY Methodology](https://docs.superform.xyz/learn/apy-methodology): How `apy_snapshot_*` and `reward_rate` are computed, sentinel values, and display guidance.
- [Client Library](https://docs.superform.xyz/build/sdk): TypeScript and Python copy-paste clients for Persephone + Bundler.
- [Deployment Addresses](https://docs.superform.xyz/deployment-addresses): All contract addresses and SuperVault instance addresses across chains.

## Learn

- [Superform Protocol](https://docs.superform.xyz/learn/learn): Core architecture — Superform Core, Periphery, SuperVaults, SuperAssets.
- [Superform Core](https://docs.superform.xyz/learn/superform-core): Persistent onchain contracts, Merkle-verified execution, ERC-7579 smart accounts.
- [Smart Accounts](https://docs.superform.xyz/learn/smart-accounts): SuperValidator, SuperExecutor, ERC-4337 / EIP-7702 account abstraction.
- [Hooks](https://docs.superform.xyz/learn/hooks): Composable action modules (bridge, swap, lend). Classification: INFLOW, OUTFLOW, NONACCOUNTING.
- [SuperVaults](https://docs.superform.xyz/learn/supervaults): Key properties, how they work, security model, transparency, architecture, yield sources.
- [Transaction Lifecycle](https://docs.superform.xyz/learn/supervaults/transaction-lifecycle): Deposit, PPS update, strategy management, and redemption flows step by step.
- [Economics](https://docs.superform.xyz/learn/supervaults/economics): Fee model, PPS mechanics, performance fee accounting.
- [APY Methodology](https://docs.superform.xyz/learn/apy-methodology): Exact formula, window definitions, sentinel, reward_rate vs apy_snapshot.
- [$UP Token](https://docs.superform.xyz/learn/usdup): Utility token — upkeep, governance, validator bonding.
- [Glossary](https://docs.superform.xyz/learn/glossary): Definitions of key v2 terms.
- [Links](https://docs.superform.xyz/learn/links): Official resources — website, GitHub, audits, whitepaper.

## Build

- [Build Overview](https://docs.superform.xyz/build): Three paths: Earn (integrate SuperVaults), write hooks, become a validator.
- [Earn](https://docs.superform.xyz/build/integrate-supervaults): Overview + prerequisites + wallet type routing.
- [Vault Data](https://docs.superform.xyz/build/earn/vault-data): Vault discovery and user positions.
- [Deposit](https://docs.superform.xyz/build/earn/deposit): Deposit flows.
- [Redemption](https://docs.superform.xyz/build/earn/redemption): Async redemption lifecycle.
- [Rewards](https://docs.superform.xyz/build/earn/rewards): Merkl reward display and claiming.
- [Client Library](https://docs.superform.xyz/build/sdk): TypeScript and Python clients wrapping Persephone + Bundler. Copy-paste ready.
- [Write a Hook](https://docs.superform.xyz/build/hooks): Build custom composable hook contracts — lifecycle, classifications, quickstart, testing.
- [Operate a SuperVault](https://docs.superform.xyz/build/manage-a-supervault): Onchain vault creation, manager roles, hook execution, fee configuration, redemption fulfillment.
- [Become a Validator](https://docs.superform.xyz/build/become-a-validator): Join the PPS validator network — infrastructure, node setup, configuration, operations, economics.

## Operate

- [SuperformOS Overview](https://docs.superform.xyz/operate): Operating layer for programmable vaults.
- [Prerequisites](https://docs.superform.xyz/operate/prerequisites): Access requirements, KYC, $UP staking.
- [Authentication](https://docs.superform.xyz/operate/authentication): JWT flow, Erebor API auth, programmatic authentication.
- [Permissions Model](https://docs.superform.xyz/operate/permissions): Primary manager, secondary manager, view-only, registry maintainer, session key roles.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.superform.xyz/operate/quickstart): End-to-end vault launch — create, upkeep, yield sources, hooks, strategy, distribute.
- [Create Vault](https://docs.superform.xyz/operate/ui/create-vault): Vault wizard walkthrough.
- [Setup Checklist](https://docs.superform.xyz/operate/ui/setup-checklist): Canonical go-live readiness checklist.
- [Strategy DSL](https://docs.superform.xyz/operate/strategy/dsl): Strategy definition language — conditions, actions, ordering.
- [Merkle Trees](https://docs.superform.xyz/operate/ui/merkle-trees): Hook authorization, root generation, proof publishing.
- [Yield Sources](https://docs.superform.xyz/operate/ui/yield-sources): Whitelist management, oracle pairing, emergency exit.
- [Pause Operations](https://docs.superform.xyz/operate/ui/pause): Vault pause, keeper pause, emergency exit.
- [Erebor API Reference](https://docs.superform.xyz/operate/api/erebor): Full management API — vaults, users, merkle, upkeep.
- [Strategy Engine API](https://docs.superform.xyz/operate/api/strategy): Strategy CRUD, intent ordering, emergency locks.
- [OMS API](https://docs.superform.xyz/operate/api/oms): DeFiX intent execution, session keys, hook transactions.
